from latest import latest_report


def test_latest_report_returns_the_latest_dated_report(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'report-a.txt').write_text('title: winter review\ndate: 2024-01-05\n')
    (tmp_path / 'report-b.txt').write_text('title: spring review\ndate: 2024-03-01\n')
    assert latest_report(tmp_path) == tmp_path / 'report-b.txt'


def test_file_names_carry_no_order(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'report-a.txt').write_text('date: 2024-03-01\n')
    (tmp_path / 'report-b.txt').write_text('date: 2024-01-05\n')
    assert latest_report(tmp_path) == tmp_path / 'report-a.txt'


def test_date_line_may_follow_other_lines_and_year_decides(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'a.txt').write_text('title: x\nbody\ndate: 2023-12-31\n')
    (tmp_path / 'b.txt').write_text('title: y\nbody\ndate: 2024-01-01\n')
    assert latest_report(tmp_path) == tmp_path / 'b.txt'


def test_only_txt_files_directly_in_folder_count(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / 'a.txt').write_text('date: 2024-01-01\n')
    (tmp_path / 'b.md').write_text('date: 2025-01-01\n')
    sub = tmp_path / 'sub'
    sub.mkdir()
    (sub / 'c.txt').write_text('date: 2026-01-01\n')
    assert latest_report(tmp_path) == tmp_path / 'a.txt'
EOF

from pathlib import Path


def _report_date(report: Path) -> str:
    for line in report.read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith('date:'):
            return line[len('date:'):].strip()
    raise ValueError(f'no date line in {report}')


def latest_report(folder: Path) -> Path:
    """Return the .txt report in folder whose `date:` line is the latest."""
    return max(folder.glob('*.txt'), key=_report_date)
EOF
